prompt: A realistic Pinterest and Instagram lifestyle photography scene captured with a professional DSLR camera, 4:3 aspect ratio. Create exactly THREE large transparent floating full-length glass mirrors only, arranged in a diagonal depth-perspective composition inside a modern cozy Korean apartment bedroom. The mirrors should look like frameless vertical glass slabs with subtle thin reflective edges and faint transparency, standing/floating naturally on a warm light wood floor. Mirror 1 is the largest in the left foreground, angled slightly toward camera, reflecting a young Korean woman taking a phone mirror selfie; she wears a cream oversized hoodie and light gray shorts, has dark hair in a relaxed messy bun, bare legs and bare feet, soft natural smile, one hand in hoodie pocket, holding a beige smartphone. Mirror 2 is medium sized in the center midground, farther back, reflecting the same woman standing casually in a loose white T-shirt and black shorts, long dark hair down, hands in pockets, barefoot, looking to the side. Mirror 3 is the smallest in the right background, farther away, reflecting the woman seated cross-legged on the floor or bed area in a pale blue hoodie, holding a phone selfie pose. The apartment is bright, calm, and airy, with sheer white curtains and beige drapes on the left, soft morning sunlight streaming across the wood floor, a neutral sofa partly visible in the left mirror reflection, a white round rug, framed minimalist wall art, potted green plants including a tall plant in a woven basket, a small wooden stool, beige closet doors in the background, and a blurred blue-gray bed edge in the right foreground. Use warm natural daylight, soft shadows, shallow depth of field, photorealistic skin and fabric textures, clean Korean home decor, cozy minimalism, DSLR lifestyle photography, 35mm lens feel, f/2.8, high-resolution realism. Keep the composition uncluttered and dreamy but believable. Constraints: exactly 3 mirrors, exactly 3 reflected versions of the woman, no extra mirrors, no extra people, no text, no logos, no surreal distortions beyond transparent floating mirror effect.

promptZh: 一张由专业单反相机拍摄的 Pinterest 和 Instagram 风格生活方式摄影作品，比例为 4:3。画面中仅包含三面大型透明浮动全身玻璃镜，以对角线深度透视构图排列在现代温馨的韩式公寓卧室中。镜子呈现为无框垂直玻璃板，带有精致的薄反射边缘和淡淡的透明感，自然地立于或悬浮在温暖的浅色木地板上。第一面镜子位于左侧前景，尺寸最大，略微朝向相机，反射出一位年轻韩国女性正在进行手机镜面自拍；她身着 米色超大款连帽衫和浅灰色短裤，留着 深色随性丸子头，光腿赤足，面带柔和自然的微笑，一只手插在连帽衫口袋里，手持米色智能手机。第二面镜子位于中心中景，位置靠后，尺寸中等，反射出同一位女性身着 宽松白色 T 恤和黑色短裤 随意站立，深色长发披肩，双手插兜，赤脚，看向侧方。第三面镜子位于右侧背景，尺寸最小，距离最远，反射出该女性盘腿坐在地板或床区，身着 淡蓝色连帽衫，摆出手机自拍姿势。公寓明亮、宁静且通透，左侧挂有白色薄纱窗帘和米色窗帘，柔和的晨光洒在木地板上，左侧镜面反射中可见部分中性色沙发，配有白色圆形地毯、极简主义墙面艺术画、包括编织篮中高大植株在内的盆栽绿植、小木凳、背景中的米色衣柜门，以及右侧前景中模糊的蓝灰色床沿。使用温暖的自然日光、柔和的阴影、浅景深、照片级的皮肤和织物纹理、整洁的韩式家居装饰、温馨极简主义、单反生活方式摄影、35mm 镜头质感、f/2.8 光圈、高分辨率写实效果。保持构图简洁、梦幻且真实可信。限制条件：必须正好 3 面镜子，正好 3 个女性反射版本，不得有额外镜子，不得有额外人物，不得有文字，不得有 Logo，除透明浮动镜面效果外不得有超现实扭曲。
